note: Eval set in the agentskills.io evals/evals.json format. Static assertions are regex contracts over SKILL.md; live assertions need a real repo + tasks/plan.md and are recorded as not-run.

evals.prompt: Run /iii-build-plan on a tasks/plan.md with 3 open tasks. Execute only the next open task.
evals.expected_output: Exactly one task implemented with minimal clean code, code-simplification applied, one local commit in <type>(<scope>): <summary> (#<issue>) format, the task marked [x] in tasks/plan.md, then halt for inspection. No second task started.

static_assertions.why: Mode B must pick exactly one task and halt
Mode B must stop after the single task for operator review
completed tasks must be marked [x] in tasks/plan.md
commit message format is a contract downstream stations rely on

live_assertions: Only the single next open task is implemented
The task is marked [x] in tasks/plan.md
Exactly one local commit is created for the task
Execution halts after the single task for inspection

evals.prompt: Run /iii-build-plan auto on a tasks/plan.md with one UI task and one backend task.
evals.expected_output: All tasks executed sequentially with domain routing (UI to frontend-ui-engineering, backend to TDD), final report in Hebrew grouped by change type, ending with next step /iv-review-build-and-pr.

static_assertions.why: auto mode must execute every task, not just one
UI/Frontend tasks must route to the frontend skill
code/backend tasks must route to TDD
every task gets simplification pass before commit
build must hand off to Station IV

static_assertions.pattern: chat output template for this station is\s+`references/output-template\.md`
static_assertions.why: the Hebrew output contract is extracted to references/output-template.md; SKILL.md must carry the pointer that loads it
out-of-scope findings must be captured, never silently fixed

live_assertions: All open tasks in tasks/plan.md are executed sequentially
Final report is in Hebrew with change groups
Final report points to /iv-review-build-and-pr as the next step

evals.prompt: Run /iii-build-plan in a repo with no tasks/plan.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill must not invent work: halt with 'No plan found! Run /ii-plan-issue first.' No code written, no commit created.

static_assertions.why: the plan file is a hard prerequisite
missing plan must halt with an explicit message
the halt must direct operator back to planning
a catch-all trigger would fire without a plan

live_assertions: No code is written when tasks/plan.md is missing
No commit is created when tasks/plan.md is missing
The halt message directs the operator to /ii-plan-issue
